title: Join us on Friday, February 27th, 2026 for our next session of the Public Webinar Series!
summary: Discover how somatic mosaicism is being studied across human tissues through cutting-edge datasets, analytical approaches, and an accessible data portal designed to accelerate biomedical discovery.
bodyHtml:
Join the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE) Public Webinar Series for an exciting session featuring Hye-Jung Elizabeth Chun, PhD who will presesent on "Somatic Mosaicism across Human Tissues: Data, Analysis, and Data Portal"

Discover how somatic mosaicism is being studied across human tissues through cutting-edge datasets, analytical approaches, and an accessible data portal designed to accelerate biomedical discovery.

📅 Friday, February 27, 2026
🕐 1–2 PM ET
💻 Register here: https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_x0bGLLt4TbqFGlxlMM-T2A

Don’t miss this opportunity to learn from experts at the forefront of data-driven human biology research!

Explore the SMaHT resource.
